name: Dutchess - Lynwood
menu_url: https://dutchesscanna.com/stores/lynwood-illinois (Dutchie-hosted equivalent: https://dutchie.com/embedded-menu/6852f6b45f9646fe0127f4e0 and https://dutchie.com/dispensary/lynwood-illinois). Recreational menu; pricingType=rec toggle in the UI.
how_menu_reached: Dutchie 'Ecommerce Pro' white-label storefront: the retailer domain dutchesscanna.com (WordPress marketing site) reverse-proxies /stores/<slug>-illinois to a Dutchie Next.js app (assets2.dutchie.com chunks, __NEXT_DATA__ with Apollo state). Not an iframe, not a plugin script, not a dutchie.com link: the menu is rendered first-party on the retailer host. JSON-LD @type Store on the page carries the branch street address. The same chain site serves all Dutchess branches (chainId 'dutchess').
branch_selection: URL path slug (/stores/lynwood-illinois) fixes the branch. The SSR HTML embeds "dispensaryId":"6852f6b45f9646fe0127f4e0" and "chainId":"dutchess"; every GraphQL call carries that dispensaryId in variables. Chain list (query getChainDispensaries, dispensaryFilter chain=dutchess) returns all branches with id, cName slug, address, status=open.
age_gate: click-through (Dutchie 'yes/21+' overlay; probe auto-click works). Menu GraphQL responded 200 without any login.

data_loading.mechanism: GraphQL over GET with Apollo persisted queries, same-origin on the retailer host (and identically on dutchie.com/api-0/graphql for the embedded-menu form)
endpoints: GET .../api-0/graphql?operationName=MenuFiltersV2 | GetMenuSections | GetCollectionsNavigation | GetCollection | GetAddressBasedDispensaryData (taxes, delivery) | getChainDispensaries | GetSpecialMenuCards | PriceRangeFilterSettings
data_loading.notes: The home view only issues collection-scoped FilteredProducts (collectionId set, 25 per page, e.g. 'Royal Deals'); the whole menu is the same query with no collectionId/types. Product shape: Name, Options[] (sizes like '3.5g'), recPrices[], recSpecialPrices[], medicalPrices[], type, subcategory, THCContent.range, Status, weight, isBelowThreshold. API version number in the path differs per white-label host (dutchess api-0, maribis/stashouse api-3); persisted-query hash was identical (cfbda410...) on all of them. Raw (non-browser) HTTP: same-origin GET without a Referer returned a 404 WordPress page; with Referer https://dutchesscanna.com/stores/... it returned the JSON (200). Direct https://dutchie.com/api-3/graphql from curl hit a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' 403 (browser context is fine). No challenge seen in Chrome.

paging: page (0-based) + perPage; perPage is capped at 100 (500 returned 98-100). queryInfo.totalCount / totalPages declared on every response. Measured on the whole menu (no filter): totalCount 727, 8 pages at perPage 100 (7x100 + 27), 30 pages at perPage 25; union of unique product ids = 727 = declared total (perfect reconcile). Category totals sum to 727 (Flower 221, Pre-Rolls 153, Edible 138, Vaporizers 118, Accessories 60, Concentrate 32, Topicals 3, Tincture 2).
license_channels: recreational menu (pricingType rec); medical prices come as parallel medicalPrices arrays / pricingType=med on the same product set. Registry serves_medical=0.
blockers: raw HTTP to dutchie.com/api-N/graphql gets a Cloudflare JS challenge (403) - do not evade; use the browser path

why_it_fails: Fails at website discovery, before any menu fetch. backend/locators.py CONNECTORS has no entry for 'dutchess', so the connector stage returns 'No retailer locator connector configured'. The fallback search (site_discovery.search_websites, OpenRouter/Exa) then surfaced only a Joint Commerce directory page for Lynwood; is_directory_url() classifies it as a lead and it is never followed to the retailer, so dutchesscanna.com/stores/lynwood-illinois (whose JSON-LD address matches the registry exactly and whose HTML contains the single dispensaryId that dutchie_page_endpoints() would turn into a dutchie endpoint) is never inspected. Downstream the Dutchie path is already capable (embedded-menu/<id> browser path, whole-menu paging); the chain is simply never reached.
fix_idea: (1) Add chain connectors for white-label Dutchie chains: ('dutchess', 'https://dutchesscanna.com/'), plus maribis and stashouse (see sibling maps). The root page lists /stores/<city>-illinois links; the existing city-token link matcher in _known_menu_candidates would select /stores/lynwood-illinois. (2) Better and shared: a Dutchie white-label chain locator that calls getChainDispensaries (or reads the /stores hub) and matches branches by address/coordinates, returning dutchie.com/embedded-menu/<dispensaryId> endpoints directly. (3) In the Dutchie fetch, request removeProductsBelowOptionThresholds=false and sortBy=name/isDefaultSort=false so paging is stable (see Markham/Oak Park maps); Lynwood reconciles even with defaults.
